class.name: FilesManifest
class.brief_description: A resource that describes a set of files to load together.

method.name: matches_extension
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the file name of [param path] ends with one of the [member extensions] (case-insensitive), or if [member extensions] is empty.

method.name: normalize_extension
method.description: Returns [param extension] in the form used by [member extensions]: lowercase with a leading dot. [code]"png"[/code], [code]"*.PNG"[/code] and [code]".png"[/code] all become [code]".png"[/code]. Returns an empty string for an empty extension.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], folders of [member folder_paths] that do not exist are created (with their parent folders) instead of reporting an error. Folders on read-only paths, such as [code]res://[/code] in an exported project, cannot be created and still report an error.

The extensions of the files to take from [member folder_paths]. They are normalized with [method normalize_extension] and duplicates are removed. Multi-part extensions such as [code].tres.json[/code] are supported. If empty, all files that a resource loader recognizes are taken.
Single files that belong to the manifest. They are always included, regardless of [member extensions] and [member type_hint]. Files that do not exist report an error and are skipped.
The folders to take files from. Folders that do not exist report an error, unless [member create_non_existing_folders] is [code]true[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the subfolders of [member folder_paths] are searched too. Hidden folders are skipped.

The class of the resources, for example [Texture2D]. If it is a built-in class, files in [member folder_paths] whose resource type is known and does not inherit from it are skipped, and the hint is passed to the loaders. Class names of scripts do not filter and are not passed to the loaders. If empty, files of all types are taken.
